create_json_index_dataset: create a JsonIndexDataset from CO3D-style JSON annotation files with configurable frame and sequence filtering
join_json_datasets: join multiple JsonIndexDataset objects into a single dataset combining frame and sequence annotations
subset_from_frame_index: generate a dataset subset by filtering frames using a list of sequence name and frame number tuples
get_all_train_cameras: get all cameras from known train frames and return them joined as a batched CamerasBase object
seq_frame_index_to_dataset_index: convert sequence name and frame number tuples into dataset indices for batch sampling
